_readme: Youth classes for the Classes tab on Family outings, verified against each program's own site or the SF Rec & Park catalog on 2026-10-13 (Mission, Bernal Heights and nearby). Fields: cat (martial|sports|arts|stem), activity, ages [min,max], when (schedule summary), signup (dropin|trial|term|membership), price (text), free (true/false/unset), url, note. Rec & Park sessions end in December; refresh their dates each term.

classes.name: Magalit Jiu Jitsu Academy
classes.when: Under 12: Mon & Wed 4–4:45 pm, Sat 10 am · Under 6: Thu 5 pm, Sat 9 am
classes.note: Kids' gi classes with coach Travis Magalit; start with a free trial.

classes.name: ABADÁ-Capoeira SF
classes.when: Ages 5–7: Tue/Thu 4 pm, Sat 1 pm · Ages 8–12: Tue/Thu 5 pm, Sat 2 pm · Teens free

classes.name: Quantum Martial Arts
classes.when: Kids 6–9 most weekdays after school and Sat 10 am · Ages 4–5: Mon/Wed 4:15, Fri 4 pm
classes.note: Nonprofit dojo; first week free, then monthly membership on a sliding scale.

classes.name: Project Commotion
classes.when: Ages 0–3 Mon 4 pm · 3–5 Thu & Fri 4 pm · 6–12 Mon & Fri 5 pm · Teens Wed 6 pm
classes.note: Bilingual movement nonprofit; capoeira, fitness and creative movement by age. Sliding scale.

classes.when: After-school youth classes; schedule on the gym's site
